about: A terminal viewer for images, videos, PDFs, Markdown and office documents.

prs.title: Word documents turn into Markdown without stray text
prs.broken: Converting a Word file printed deleted tracked changes, hidden page number codes, and split a heading at the very top onto two lines.
prs.changed: Only the visible text of the document is now kept.
prs.matters: The Markdown reads like the document you see in Word.

prs.title: Spreadsheet dates show as dates
prs.broken: Date cells in Excel files came out as raw serial numbers like 45366 instead of a date.
prs.changed: Dates are now written as year, month and day, with the time when the cell has one.
prs.matters: Tables made from spreadsheets can be read without decoding the numbers.
